nodes.label: js/bridge.js (IE page bridge)
nodes.rationale: The only file that names a host transport (chrome.webview, webkit messageHandlers, window.external); carries its own JSON fallback and attachEvent-based ose.listen for IE quirks mode.

nodes.label: HtmlMessage (JSON envelope)
nodes.rationale: Flat JSON with no version field because page and C# always ship in the same exe; TryParse does not parse dates.

nodes.label: IeHtmlHost (IE WebBrowser host)
nodes.rationale: Delivery is asynchronous even on IE (BeginInvoke) to copy WebView2 timing, so code relying on IE's synchronous re-entry fails early where it can be compared against the released exe.

nodes.label: IHtmlHost interface
nodes.rationale: Every HTML host talks to its page only through one small interface over a JSON message channel so WebView2 (sub-project C) only needs a new host implementation; C# never touches the DOM.

nodes.label: FallbackHtmlHost (automatic IE fallback)
nodes.rationale: Never a blank pane: on WebView2 start-up or process failure, swaps in IeHtmlHost, persists WebView2FailedLastRun and raises EngineChanged so owners reload with IE scripts.

nodes.label: WebView2HtmlHost
nodes.rationale: The only file that touches WebView2 types; user data folder under LOCALAPPDATA because Program Files is read-only; x86 loader because StoryEditor is x86.

nodes.label: Bounded Request with DoEvents pumping
nodes.rationale: Keeps today's synchronous-read semantics where C# needs page state now; waits only for its own rid so nested Requests are safe; same pattern works for WebView2.

nodes.label: Save flush (FlushPendingEdits)
nodes.rationale: Asynchronous delivery means the last typing may not have reached the model; flush requests each pane before save. Unresponsive pane gives Retry / Save without latest typing / Cancel because refusing to save would risk everything since last save, and F5 rebuilds from the model and loses the edit.

nodes.label: Symmetric loading: FromXml mirrors GetXml
nodes.rationale: One loader replaces both DataSet and XmlNode paths, moving off the DataSet/XmlNode world ahead of .NET 8 (sub-project D).

nodes.label: BeginInvoke delivery of WebMessageReceived
nodes.rationale: Spike Q6: a Request made inside a WebMessageReceived handler always times out, since WebView2 raises no further messages while a handler runs.

nodes.label: Engine choice (WebView2 default, IE setting, runtime probe)
nodes.norm_label: engine choice (webview2 default, ie setting, runtime probe)
nodes.rationale: WebView2 wherever the runtime works, automatic fallback to IE, and a 'Use the IE browser panes' setting (takes effect after restart).

nodes.label: HTML5 drag-and-drop of Bible references
nodes.rationale: Provisional (spike Q3 unverified because desktop was locked); fallback is WinForms DoDragDrop with a UnicodeText DataObject so Chromium accepts the drop. HtmlDragSuspension keeps SuspendSaveDialog balanced.

nodes.label: In-memory page delivery via WebResourceRequested (https://ose.pane)
nodes.rationale: Avoids the 2 MB NavigateToString limit and temp files; serves only page.html for the current doc id, 404 otherwise.

nodes.label: NavigationStarting guard and page-level preventDefault for keys
nodes.norm_label: navigationstarting guard and page-level preventdefault for keys
nodes.rationale: WinForms WebView2 control doesn't expose AcceleratorKeyPressed, so page keydown prevents F5/Ctrl+R/Ctrl+P and the navigation guard cancels reload/back/forward.

nodes.label: WebView2 start-up failure detection (20 s watchdog)
nodes.norm_label: webview2 start-up failure detection (20 s watchdog)
nodes.rationale: Spike Q4: missing runtime throws WebView2RuntimeNotFoundException; bad data folder fails in EnsureCoreWebView2Async; 1 of 7 runs hung silently, hence any exception, IsSuccess false, or a 20 s watchdog counts as failure.

nodes.label: FallbackHtmlHost
nodes.rationale: Wraps the WebView2 host; on failure swaps an IE host into the same container, replays the last page and raises EngineChanged so the owner rebuilds with IE scripts. The user never sees a blank pane.

nodes.label: HtmlHostFactory
nodes.rationale: Chooses engine (WhyNotWebView2), remembers failure per runtime version (a failure on an older runtime doesn't count, an update may have fixed it), gives a once-per-session notice.

nodes.label: HtmlMessageChannel
nodes.rationale: Bookkeeping (doc ids, queued posts until 'ready', rid/reply matching, bounded Request wait) moved out of IeHtmlHost so both hosts behave identically.

nodes.label: WebView2HtmlHost
nodes.rationale: The only class allowed to touch Microsoft.Web.WebView2 types; implements IHtmlHost and IFailingHtmlHost; pages served from memory to avoid NavigateToString's 2 MB limit.

nodes.label: In-memory page serving at https://ose.pane via WebResourceRequested
nodes.norm_label: in-memory page serving at https://ose.pane via webresourcerequested
nodes.rationale: Avoids NavigateToString 2 MB limit; must be UTF-8 end to end so non-ASCII story text isn't garbled.

nodes.label: Installer: WebView2 SDK DLLs + Evergreen bootstrapper custom action
nodes.norm_label: installer: webview2 sdk dlls + evergreen bootstrapper custom action
nodes.rationale: Runs MicrosoftEdgeWebview2Setup.exe silently when no runtime is found in registry; failure (e.g. offline) is ignored and the app uses IE panes.

nodes.label: Navigation guard (cancel navigations host didn't start)
nodes.norm_label: navigation guard (cancel navigations host didn't start)
nodes.rationale: Back/forward, script navigation or links could show a stale story or outside URL; only the expected https://ose.pane/page.html?d=docId is allowed.

nodes.label: WebView2 start-up watchdog (20 s)
nodes.rationale: WebView2 can hang without throwing, leaving blank panes forever; the watchdog treats a hang as failure so FallbackHtmlHost swaps to IE.

nodes.label: UseWebView2WhenAvailable gate
nodes.rationale: Stays false until Task 7 so the app always uses IE until every page has its modern scripts.

nodes.label: Story/BT selection highlighting via getHighlights
nodes.rationale: Must-keep feature; rendering (TriggerMyBlur highlight spans) stays identical on IE, only how C# reads them changes; reply format stays the same for WebView2.

nodes.label: Mirror-layer highlight behind transparent textarea
nodes.rationale: Chromium can't draw inside a textarea, so a highlighted box gets a mirror div with identical text metrics and the range in a <mark>; any edit clears the highlight so 'Add note' never quotes stale text.

nodes.label: Separate Modern* test fixtures
nodes.rationale: Modern page tests are separate fixtures rather than engine parameters, so IE fixtures keep their quirks-mode drivers.

nodes.label: Mirror (backdrop) highlight technique
nodes.rationale: Keeps story fields as textareas (editable divs rejected: would change paste, line breaks, IME and Keyman for all users). Spike Q5 confirmed alignment across wrapping, scrolling, Devanagari and RTL; mirror must reserve scrollbar width (left in RTL).

nodes.label: Legacy Note HTML (ConsultantNote/CoachNote/ReferringText)
nodes.rationale: Notes contain real HTML (create-note spans, typed <B>/<EM>, captured pane HTML, even a <SCRIPT> with window.external) rendered unsanitized today; never rewritten in storage, sanitized only at render.

nodes.label: NoteHtmlSanitizer (allowlist)
nodes.rationale: Allowlist tags span p br i b em strong u a, app-generated Lang*/field classes, http(s) hrefs; internal links unwrapped to text to avoid nested links; script/style removed with content; falls back to encoded text on failure. Too-strict allowlist loses nothing since storage is unchanged.

nodes.label: TextareaOnKeyUp / TextareaOnChange Route Split
nodes.rationale: keyup sends plain this.value; onchange sends htmlText-derived HTML, so only onchange is decoded with FromIeHtmlText; no JS changes.

nodes.label: User Angle-Bracket Pseudo-Tags (<donkey bray>, <RTL>)
nodes.rationale: IE hid these as unknown tags; now escaped before sanitizing so they show as written.

nodes.label: Private-Use Sentinel Search Highlight
nodes.rationale: U+E000/U+E001 mark the found range before sanitizing; highlight is applied only if output minus sentinels equals the unhighlighted render, otherwise falls back without leaking sentinels.

nodes.label: FormatLanguageColumnHtml Takes HTML Contract
nodes.rationale: Some callers pass Diff.HtmlDiff output, so it cannot encode its input; HtmlDiff encodes its emitted text and plain-text callers encode first.

nodes.label: ArchitectureGuardTests (WebView2 boundaries)
nodes.rationale: Enforce: WebView2 types only in WebView2HtmlHost.cs, chrome.webview only in js/modern/bridge.js, window.external only in js/bridge.js, no IE-only APIs in js/modern.

nodes.label: js/modern/bridge.js

nodes.label: PageScriptSet / PageScripts.For(engine)
nodes.rationale: IE keeps today's quirks-mode scripts untouched; WebView2 gets js/modern scripts in standards mode (ApplyDoctype) speaking the same protocol.

nodes.label: HtmlVerseControl (UserControl holding a host)
nodes.rationale: Panes keep their class names so designer files and callers change as little as possible; only the base class changes from WebBrowser to UserControl.

nodes.label: Typed per-pane message dispatcher
nodes.rationale: Replaces COM's quiet string-to-int/bool coercion; unknown types are logged and ignored and handler exceptions caught so one bad message can't take down the message loop.

nodes.label: WebView2 Panes (Sub-project C) Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Run StoryEditor HTML panes in WebView2 (Chromium, Evergreen) by default with automatic IE fallback, keeping every user-visible behaviour; IE path left untouched; no data/file-format change.

nodes.label: IE pane fallback when WebView2 missing
nodes.norm_label: ie pane fallback when webview2 missing
nodes.rationale: Installer runs the bootstrapper silently only when no runtime is installed and ignores failure (e.g. offline); the app then falls back to IE panes.

nodes.label: ArchitectureGuardTests
nodes.rationale: Keeps sub-project B rules from regressing: only bridge.js uses window.external and only IeHtmlHost.cs touches HtmlElement/HtmlDocument/InvokeScript/mshtml etc. Sub-project C relies on both.

nodes.label: bridge.js (page transport: ose.send/on, oseReceive)
nodes.rationale: Only page script that knows which browser hosts it (chrome.webview, webkit, window.external). Also carries ose.closest, ose.cancel and scrollTo because every page needs them.

nodes.label: BrowserTestHelper (off-screen form, PumpUntil)
nodes.rationale: Tests must never block on UI: off-screen Form at (-32000,-32000) and pumping with a timeout; no message boxes.

nodes.label: 'flush' page command
nodes.rationale: Sends textChanged quiet:true for the last-focused, non-readonly textarea before replying; Story/BT overrides it to send IE htmlText the onchange way.

nodes.label: HtmlHostFactory
nodes.rationale: Single creation point; sub-project C adds the setting that chooses the WebView2 host here.

nodes.label: HtmlMessageDispatcher
nodes.rationale: One bad message must never take down the message loop: unknown types are logged, handler exceptions are caught and reported via ReportError (status bar).

nodes.label: HtmlVerseControl (pane base UserControl)
nodes.rationale: Becomes a UserControl holding an IHtmlHost instead of being the IE WebBrowser; talks to its page only through messages.

nodes.label: IeHtmlHost (IE WebBrowser implementation)
nodes.rationale: Only class allowed to touch WebBrowser/HtmlDocument. JS->C# via one COM method postMessage(json) delivered with BeginInvoke so timing matches WebView2's async WebMessageReceived; C#->JS via InvokeScript('oseReceive', json).

nodes.label: IHtmlHost interface
nodes.rationale: How C# talks to an HTML page: LoadHtml, Post (queued until ready), bounded Request, MessageReceived/DocumentReady events, ShowPrintPreview. Nothing else may touch the browser.

nodes.label: Removal of mshtml reference and OseResources
nodes.norm_label: removal of mshtml reference and oseresources

nodes.label: NoteActions (data-action names and ButtonHtml)
nodes.rationale: ButtonHtml replaces the HTML_ButtonClass resx template because one button needs a data-arg and the others don't.

nodes.label: PaneCommon.js (shared pane handlers)
nodes.rationale: Shared by Story/BT and note panes: cancels link navigation, sends data-action buttons, Ctrl+S/F5, scripture drops, scroll reports, and handles setText/appendText/selectRange/replaceSelection/flush commands.

nodes.label: PaneFlush (flush policy)
nodes.rationale: Before any save every pane is asked to send unsent edits; when one doesn't answer the user picks Retry / Save without latest typing / Cancel; autosave never asks and just skips.

nodes.label: ReferringTextBuilder
nodes.rationale: Ported line for line from HtmlStoryBtControl.AddNote, including the quirk that compares a reference name with a type name so every item starts a new ' vs: ' part, so notes come out the same.

nodes.label: HTML Pane Message Protocol Implementation Plan (Sub-project B)
nodes.norm_label: html pane message protocol implementation plan (sub-project b)
nodes.rationale: Every HTML host talks to its page only through IHtmlHost, a JSON message channel: no window.external.X, no C# DOM access, no mshtml. IE stays the only browser with no user-visible behaviour change, preparing for sub-project C (WebView2).

nodes.label: Bounded Request with message pump
nodes.rationale: C# asks page state with a rid-tagged Request that pumps Application.DoEvents until a reply or the 2s HtmlHostDefaults.RequestTimeout; a JS handler that throws replies immediately with 'error' rather than hanging; late replies are dropped.

nodes.label: Document id guard (ignore stale 'ready')
nodes.rationale: __OSE_DOC_ID__ token replaced on each LoadHtml so a 'ready' from an older document arriving after a new LoadHtml is ignored and posts don't go to a half-loaded page.

nodes.label: Flush panes before every save path
nodes.norm_label: flush panes before every save path
nodes.rationale: The flush happens before the Modified check at all four save entry points (SaveClicked, CheckForSaveDirtyFileNoCleanup, FormClosing, autosave tick) so edits not yet sent (e.g. mouse paste without keyup) are saved.

nodes.label: No inline event handlers (data-action / data-mouseup / data-drop attributes)
nodes.norm_label: no inline event handlers (data-action / data-mouseup / data-drop attributes)
nodes.rationale: Generated HTML carries data-* attributes instead of on* handlers calling window.external; page scripts turn them into 'action'/'scriptureDropped' messages. Page_HasNoInlineEventHandlers tests enforce it.

nodes.label: Unchanged text never sets Modified
nodes.rationale: Applied to every textChanged, not only flush; otherwise a flush or an arrow key would mark the project modified and cause a spurious 'save changes?' prompt on every close.
